description.value: TV Dinner is a neighborhood market and café offering frozen and refrigerated foods, pantry staples, and quality coffee. It provides convenient meal options and casual food stops for cyclists and pedestrians passing through the West 3rd Avenue corridor. The business emphasizes delivering convenience without sacrificing quality.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 81m; wide_stands (4 spaces) at 85m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms TV Dinner is an active market and café at the OSM address, with frozen/refrigerated foods and pantry items available for takeout. Website corroborates the address, operating hours, and business focus. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned in website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible market and café offering food and beverage options useful to touring cyclists.
